Turn the action into an unmistakable bare-handed TWO-ARM FORWARD REACH. Extend BOTH muscular arms and BOTH open hands toward screen right, with each hand, wrist, elbow and shoulder visibly connected. LOCK the approved minotaur's brown fur, horns, heavy build, dark loincloth, normal pixel scale, tall body height, planted hooves at the ready frame's exact x/y positions, leg pose, and transparent 128x128 canvas origin. No gear or weapon exists; do not add any. Preserve both legs, lower body and foot contacts pixel-for-pixel where possible. The saved footprint is 1 square wide by 2 high; attacking arms may extend over the right tile boundary while all pixels remain inside the PNG with transparent margin. Do not crop, recenter, shrink, translate the whole creature, shear or splice the upper body, add limbs, duplicate outlines, paint a backdrop, ground, checkerboard, text, border, or motion blur. Crisp readable pixel art.
